verdict.rationale: The pricing page documents an enterprise-style deployment option: running LightSprint in your own infrastructure or private cloud, plus routing model traffic through an approved gateway. That supports organization-wide licensed deployment, but nothing in the evidence mentions SSO or commercial support. GitHub-mapped permissions are an adjacent control, not SSO. missing for 10: SSO/SAML documentation, commercial support or SLA terms, an explicit enterprise license tier with terms, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can license an enterprise deployment with SSO and commercial support for organization-wide rollout

citations.quote: Run LightSprint in your own infrastructure or private cloud environment to fit stricter security and network requirements.
Route model traffic through your approved gateway so access policies and model usage remain under your control.
